who.intro:
Working in the software development field for over 15 years, with very little time to take care of personal life, we found it is hard for people to afford enough time to invest in finding the life partner.

From the experience we have and the hard time we spent in this process we believed that there should be a better way to do that.

We found that most people are still using the same old methods in finding their life mates in the era of the computer and the Internet.

The idea of using the computer to help people find their right mates has been used for a long time and no one can deny that it gave some help to some people.
But, we still believe that the existing solutions have not achieved the ultimate success.

Through KOBOOL we are introducing a different approach to achieve.

Our main goal is to make seeking the right life mate more efficient with no frustration nor hard times.

Thank you,
KOBOOL team.
